questions.markdown: Write a java program to implement a Ticket Booking System for various types of bookings, such as Movie Tickets, and Train Tickets. The system should manage and cancel recent bookings using a stack data structure (LIFO - Last In, First Out), where the most recent booking is cancelled first. Each type of ticket is inherited from a common Ticket superclass with methods `booking` and `cancel`, that follows a specific booking and cancellation policy respectively, which should be implemented using inheritance and method overriding. The system must keep track of the number of tickets in each category and the name of the Movie or Train. Define a Stack class to maintain all ticket types using `push()` and `pop()` methods. Booking happens when the ticket is pushed and cancel happens when the Ticket is popped. Implementation should showcase inheritance, polymorphism, method overriding, and dynamic method dispatch.
